My story

From a Small Room in Karachi to the Digital Mountains.

It started with a laptop, a slow connection and a lot of curiosity in a small room in Karachi. I wanted to know how the websites I loved were put together, so I opened the code and kept going. Every broken layout taught me something, and every finished page made me want to build a bigger one.

Today I study at NED University of Engineering & Technology and build websites, interfaces and interactive 3D experiences for real people. I care about the details most visitors never notice: clean structure, fast loading, smooth motion and a design that feels calm and easy to use.

My journey

The Trail So Far

Follow the trail
  1. 01
    2023

    Started Learning

    Wrote my first lines of HTML and CSS and fell for the feeling of seeing an idea appear in the browser. Evenings became tutorials, experiments and small personal pages.

  2. 02
    2024

    First Freelance Project

    Delivered my first paid website. Learned to listen to a client, plan the work, meet a deadline and ship something people actually use.

  3. 03
    2025

    Built 25+ Projects

    Landing pages, dashboards, portfolios and interactive 3D pages with React, Next.js and Three.js. Each one sharpened my eye for design and performance.

  4. 04
    2026

    Aiming for International Clients

    Took part in CodeSphere 3.0's Build4Better hackathon at NED University and set my sights on bigger summits: teams and clients around the world.

Site insights

Ali's AI assistant

Answers only from Ali's documents

How it works (RAG)
  1. Ali's CV, projects, skills, education and achievements are split into searchable chunks.
  2. Each chunk is turned into an embedding vector and stored in a vector index.
  3. Your question is embedded and the closest chunks are retrieved (vector + keyword search).
  4. A language model writes the answer using only those chunks, with numbered sources.

If the documents don't contain the answer, it says so instead of guessing.

AI answers can be imperfect — sources are shown under each answer.
